newsitem.title: USA: Optical Sensors gets ISO 9001 certification.
newsitem.headline: Optical Sensors gets ISO 9001 certification.

text.p: Optical Sensors Inc said Monday it received ISO 9001 certification which is, among other things, necessary to market products in Europe.
The ISO 9001 certifies the quality control and manufacturing systems of Optical Sensors.

The company said it expects to commercially launch its OpticalCAM blood measurement system in Europe in 1997. It is also awaiting U.S. Food and Drug Administration clearance to market the product in the United States.
